content.text: pts have suddenly fallen asleep w.o warning during daily activities, incl driving; warn about drowsiness b4 starting and ask about sedating drugs and sleep disorders. Dopaminergic drugs may cause intense urges (gambling, sex, spending, binge eating) that pts can't control; ask pts or caregivers about them specifically.

D2 antagonists (eg, phenothiazines, butyrophenones, risperidone) and INH may reduce levodopa's effect; phenytoin and papaverine have reversed its benefit. High-protein meals may delay absorb, and Fe salts (eg, in MVIs) may reduce it.
